body: EVA Air's Taipei Taoyuan to New York JFK route takes 17 hours and 15 minutes and is flown by Boeing 777-300ERs carrying 38 or 39 Royal Laurel business class seats in a 1-2-1 reverse herringbone layout, giving every passenger direct aisle access. While Singapore Airlines and Qantas draw attention for business class on routes exceeding 19 hours, EVA Air has quietly built a higher premium density on routes of almost that length.

Three flagship ultra-long-haul routes use the premium-dense 777-300ER: Taipei Taoyuan to New York JFK at 17 hours and 15 minutes, Taipei Taoyuan to Toronto Pearson about an hour shorter, and Taipei Taoyuan to Chicago O'Hare at 15 hours and 30 minutes, along with other North American destinations including Dallas/Fort Worth, Houston, Washington Dulles and Vancouver. According to EVA Air's seat maps, the three 777-300ER layouts seat 38 business, 64 premium economy and 221 economy passengers for 323 in total on the 77M; 39, 56 and 238 for 333 on the 77A; and 39, 56 and 258 for 353 on the 77B.

The 777-300ER joined EVA Air through its first major long-haul fleet renewal, which began in 2000, with the airline as one of the jet's launch customers and its first 777-300ER entering service in July 2005; the carrier now has 41 Boeing 777s, its most numerous aircraft family within a fleet of 89 jets. EVA Air has begun converting three 777-300ERs into freighters and has ordered 24 Airbus A350-1000s to replace its 777-300ERs, with no Boeing 777X orders. The Royal Laurel seats offer 60 inches of pitch and convert into lie-flat beds, and EVA Air was the first carrier to introduce premium economy on long-haul flights, debuting it on a Boeing 747-400 Taipei-Los Angeles service as Evergreen Deluxe Class.
en.summary: EVA Air's Boeing 777-300ERs carry 38 or 39 Royal Laurel business class seats in a 1-2-1 reverse herringbone layout on the 17-hour Taipei Taoyuan-JFK route, with three layouts seating 323 to 353 passengers in total.
en.title: How EVA Air fits 39 business class seats into a 17-hour flight

body: 長榮航空台北桃園—紐約甘迺迪航線飛行時間17小時15分，由波音777-300ER執飛，機上設有38或39個皇璽桂冠商務艙座位，採1-2-1反魚骨式佈局，每位乘客都能直接進出走道。相較於新加坡航空與澳洲航空等業者在19小時以上航線主打商務艙，長榮航空在接近這個航程長度的航線上悄悄打造了更高密度的高級客艙。

長榮航空共有3條旗艦超長程航線使用高密度777-300ER：台北桃園—紐約甘迺迪17小時15分、台北桃園—多倫多皮爾森約短1小時、台北桃園—芝加哥歐海爾15小時30分，另有達拉斯、休士頓、華盛頓杜勒斯與溫哥華等北美航點。依長榮航空座位圖，3種777-300ER構型的商務艙、豪華經濟艙與經濟艙座位數分別為77M型38、64、221個，總計323個；77A型39、56、238個，總計333個；77B型39、56、258個，總計353個。

777-300ER於2000年展開的長程機隊更新引進長榮航空，長榮航空為該機型的首批客戶之一，首架777-300ER於2005年7月投入服務；目前機隊共有41架波音777，為89架飛機中數量最多的機型家族。長榮航空已開始將3架777-300ER改裝為貨機，並訂購24架空中巴士A350-1000取代777-300ER，未訂購波音777X。商務艙座椅間距60英寸，可轉換為平躺睡床；長榮航空也是率先在長程航線推出豪華經濟艙的業者，首見於波音747-400台北—洛杉磯航線的菁英艙，當時稱為長榮菁英艙。
zh.summary: 長榮航空777-300ER以1-2-1反魚骨式佈局，在台北桃園—紐約甘迺迪17小時航線提供38或39個皇璽桂冠商務艙座位，3種構型總座位數323至353個。
zh.title: 長榮777-300ER塞進39個商務艙座位，17小時航線的隱形高密度佈局
